node.statement: For eta as in the preceding node, put x:=3*K*eta. Then 0<=x<=1/8, so 1-x>0 and 1-4*x>=1/2>0. Since 4*K*eta=(4/3)*x, direct common-denominator arithmetic gives 4*K*eta-x/(1-x)=x*(1-4*x)/(3*(1-x))>=0. Thus 3*K*eta/(1-3*K*eta)=x/(1-x)<=4*K*eta; combining this with 4*K*eta<=1/6<1/2 proves the remaining asserted chain.
